notes: The inspector commits to "the report to you by Mon Nov 9". On Tue Nov 10 nothing has arrived: the commitment is still open and overdue, so we must chase (next_actor us), with the Nov 13 contingency deadline close. The inspector's first reply says "report attached" but carries no attachment - that does NOT fulfil the commitment. Only the follow-up with the PDF does; at that checkpoint we should tell the inspector nothing was attached. Our booking question was answered when the inspector gave the date. Distractors: loan #, rate-lock date, invoice #, $425 fee, $20,000 EMD, MLS #, phone numbers.
